sources.source: David Tong, General Relativity, Cambridge Part III lecture notes, section 2.4.2
sources.locator: §2.4.2, The Electromagnetic Field, especially equation (2.87): antisymmetric field-strength components in a Minkowski frame.

contents.name: §2.4.2, equation (2.87): two-form field-strength components and coordinate convention
contents.support: Provides the flat-frame component convention compared with the locally proved observer decomposition; the item proves the curved tetrad formulas and contractions itself.

contents.name: §2.4.2, equation (2.87): constant Minkowski two-form component convention
contents.support: Supports the component representation used in the worked example; the local Hodge lemma supplies and proves its Lorentzian signs.

sources.source: David Tong, General Relativity, Cambridge Part III lecture notes, sections 3.1.3 and 3.2.2–3.2.3
sources.locator: §3.1.3, equations (3.97)–(3.98), Hodge dual; §§3.2.2–3.2.3, metric-compatible connection and curvature conventions.

contents.name: §3.1.3, equations (3.97)–(3.98): orientation, Hodge definition and Lorentzian star-square sign
contents.support: Supports the Hodge construction and sign convention. The proof derives the four-dimensional basis sign from the one negative metric direction.

contents.name: §3.1.3, equations (3.97)–(3.98): conformal behavior of the Hodge definition
contents.support: Motivates the conformal Hodge claim; the item derives the multiplier in every degree from inverse-metric and volume scaling.

contents.name: §3.2.2–3.2.3: connection and curvature coordinates
contents.support: Supports the fixed coordinate convention; the definition repeats the exact imported connection and curvature formulas and derives their length units.

sources.source: H. S. Reall, Part III General Relativity, Cambridge, October 12 2022 revision
sources.locator: §§2.2, 3.2, 4.2, 8.1 and 8.5; in particular equations (8.52)–(8.56) for the Lorentzian Hodge star.

contents.name: §2.2: Lorentzian orthonormal bases
contents.support: Provides an independent treatment of Lorentzian orthonormal frames; the local tetrad construction and distinctions between frames and charts are proved or cited locally.

contents.name: §§3.2 and 4.2: Levi-Civita connection and curvature conventions
contents.support: Independently checks the connection and curvature convention; the item states the exact supplier formulas and performs coordinate-unit bookkeeping.

contents.name: §8.1: differential forms, wedge product and exterior derivative
contents.support: Provides a second lecture-note treatment of the form operations; the local proof derives d-squared from the stated coordinate formula and commuting mixed partials.

contents.name: §8.5, equations (8.52)–(8.56): volume form, Hodge definition and star-square
contents.support: Independently supports the Lorentzian Hodge convention; the local proof explicitly tracks the single negative direction and normalizations.

contents.name: §8.5, equations (8.55)–(8.56): observer-frame dual components
contents.support: Supports the dual convention used locally; the item computes each time-space dual component and proves reconstruction and both invariants.

contents.name: §8.5, equations (8.55)–(8.56): constant-form star check
contents.support: Provides an independent sign check for the example; every contraction and wedge value is verified locally.
